necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as the underlying etiology. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. This study aims to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management given the high risk of thromboembolic complications.
